keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Jordan Thompson (Preston North End).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Cardiff City 0, Preston North End 1. Thierry Small (Preston North End) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Stanley Mills with a cross.
Goal! Cardiff City 0, Preston North End 2. Alfie Devine (Preston North End) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Andrew Moran.
First Half ends, Cardiff City 0, Preston North End 2.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Joel Colwill replaces Ronan Kpakio.
Krystian Bielik (Cardiff City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Calum Scanlon replaces Krystian Bielik.
Substitution, Cardiff City. Chris Willock replaces Ollie Tanner.
Goal! Cardiff City 0, Preston North End 3. Andrew Moran (Preston North End) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Cardiff City 0, Preston North End 4. Andrew Hughes (Preston North End) header from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Alfie Devine with a cross following a corner.
Joel Bagan (Cardiff City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Preston North End. Brad Potts replaces Greg Docherty.
Substitution, Preston North End. Callum Lang replaces Alfie Devine.
Substitution, Preston North End. Andrija Vukcevic replaces Andrew Moran.
Second Half ends, Cardiff City 0, Preston North End 4.
